meta.title: Linux environments
meta.description: Import and run trusted ARM64 Linux root filesystems.

trust: Linux commands run with ROOT privileges and share the Android kernel. chroot is not a security sandbox. Use only trusted rootfs archives and commands.
unsupported: Changes require Android ARM64 ROOT. Inspection remains available.
missingRuntime: The verified init helper is missing. Reinstall a complete module package before starting an environment.
ready: The management backend is available. Starting an environment checks kernel namespaces and SELinux access.
importHelp: Select a local .tar or .tar.gz archive, up to 4 GiB. Expanded data is limited to 16 GiB. The rootfs must provide ARM64 /bin/sh, /bin/sleep and /bin/cat.
name: Name
idHelp: 1–32 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens; start with a letter.
configHelp: Configuration changes apply the next time this environment starts. Saving does not restart it.
dnsHelp: Optional: one IPv4 or IPv6 address per line, up to four. Leave empty to retain the rootfs resolver configuration.
serviceHelp: Up to eight foreground commands run when the environment starts. Keep commands in the foreground; systemd is not the init process. Output is retained up to 1 MiB per stream per run.
invalidConfig: Check the name, DNS addresses and service IDs. Service IDs must be valid and unique; commands cannot be empty.
deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this stopped environment, including its rootfs and saved configuration? Export any files you need first.

errors.state_changed: The environment changed. Refresh before proceeding.
errors.state_unavailable: Environment state could not be verified.
errors.runtime_unavailable: The verified init helper is unavailable.
errors.interrupted: Environment state could not be verified.

stopConfirm: Stop all processes in this environment, including terminal sessions? Unsaved work may be lost.
